newsitem.title: USA: Clinton attends Easter service with family.
newsitem.headline: Clinton attends Easter service with family.

text.p: President Bill Clinton, his wife Hillary and daughter Chelsea attended an Easter church service on Sunday that touched on topics from winning the lottery to the Heaven's Gate mass suicide in California.
Clinton, on crutches from his knee surgery two weeks ago, left the White House for the first time in a week and hobbled into the Foundry United Methodist Church, where he regularly worships.

In addition to his wife and daughter, who returned from a two-week, six-nation tour of Africa early on Sunday, he was accompanied by members of his extended family, including his half-brother Roger Clinton and his stepfather Dick Kelley.
The sermon by the church's senior minister, Philip Wogaman, focused on the celebration of Easter, which in the Christian tradition marks the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
Wogaman, who often has touches of humour in his sermons, used a come-from-behind basketball victory and winning the lottery as metaphors for the triumph that Easter represents to many Christians.

But he also touched on darker aspects of the human soul, citing the collective suicide by 39 members of the Heaven's Gate cult in Rancho Santa Fe, California, last week as the very opposite of the Easter spirit.
"It's not like a cult group tragically making a serious mistake, hoping to catch on to an extraterrestrial spacecraft. It's not like that at all," he said. "What a sad, sad thing."
According to videotaped suicide notes, the cult members believed a spaceship hiding behind the Hale-Bopp comet nearing Earth would take them to heaven.
Clinton, dressed in a dark suit and moving carefully on his crutches, made no comment as he entered and left the church under a blue sky on a sunny spring day.

The Clintons were to spend the rest of the day at home, hosting an Easter dinner for family and friends at the White House. The menu for the 18 adults and four children invited included squash bisque, pasta salad, grilled Mediterranean vegetables, turkey scallopini, pan roasted sea bass and New York strip steak, followed by assorted pastries for dessert.
